prefs-integratedprofiles: Preferences section label for IntegratedProfiles fields.
integratedprofiles-prefs-edit-label: Label for the Special:Preferences note pointing users to the profile editor.
integratedprofiles-prefs-edit-help: Help text on Special:Preferences. Links to Special:MyPage so appearance and public fields are edited from the profile page, not preferences.
integratedprofiles-edit: Button label to open the profile editor.
integratedprofiles-edit-title: Dialog/panel title for the profile editor.
integratedprofiles-you: Badge shown next to the username when viewing your own profile.
integratedprofiles-editor-section-appear: Subheading for avatar controls in the profile editor.
integratedprofiles-editor-section-profil: Subheading for tagline and featured article fields in the profile editor.
integratedprofiles-editor-section-links: Subheading for website and social handle fields in the profile editor.
integratedprofiles-editor-section-connec: Subheading for NewAuth connected-accounts management in the profile editor.
integratedprofiles-save: Save button in the profile editor.
integratedprofiles-cancel: Cancel button in the profile editor.
integratedprofiles-modal-close: Accessible label for the close button on upload dialogs.
integratedprofiles-editor-social-links: Summary label for the collapsible Twitter/GitHub fields in the profile editor.
integratedprofiles-editor-wiki-profiles: Summary label for the collapsible MediaWiki.org / Miraheze / Fandom username fields in the profile editor.
integratedprofiles-wiki-profiles-label: Accessible name for the wiki-platform icon chips under the masthead tagline.
integratedprofiles-save-error: Error message when profile save fails.
integratedprofiles-aka:
Shown beside the username when a real name is set. Parameters:
* $1 - real name
integratedprofiles-edit-count:
Edit count line on the masthead. Parameters:
* $1 - number of edits
integratedprofiles-joined:
Account registration date on the masthead. Parameters:
* $1 - localized date
integratedprofiles-avatar-alt: Alt text for the avatar image.
integratedprofiles-avatar-change: Short button label under the avatar preview in the appearance editor.
integratedprofiles-avatar-choose: Button label for selecting an avatar image when none is set.
integratedprofiles-avatar-replace: Button label for selecting a replacement avatar image.
integratedprofiles-avatar-help:
Help text listing accepted avatar formats and size. Parameters:
* $1 - maximum size in megabytes
integratedprofiles-avatar-help-static:
Help text listing accepted avatar formats when the actor cannot upload animated avatars. Parameters:
* $1 - maximum size in megabytes
integratedprofiles-avatar-modal-title: Title for the avatar upload dialog.
integratedprofiles-avatar-confirm: Button to confirm and upload the previewed avatar image.
integratedprofiles-avatar-preview-help: Help text shown while a local avatar preview is staged but not yet uploaded.
integratedprofiles-banner-label: Label for the banner preset picker in the profile editor.
integratedprofiles-banner-help: Help text under the banner preset picker.
integratedprofiles-banner-edit: Button to open the custom banner upload dialog.
integratedprofiles-banner-choose: Button label for selecting a banner image when none is set.
integratedprofiles-banner-replace: Button label for selecting a replacement banner image.
integratedprofiles-banner-help-size:
Help text listing accepted banner formats and size. Parameters:
* $1 - maximum size in megabytes
integratedprofiles-banner-modal-title: Title for the banner upload dialog.
integratedprofiles-banner-confirm: Button to confirm and upload the previewed banner image.
integratedprofiles-banner-preview-help: Help text shown while a local banner preview is staged but not yet uploaded.
integratedprofiles-banner-preset-accent: Label for the farm-accent gradient banner preset.
integratedprofiles-banner-preset-ocean: Label for the ocean gradient banner preset.
integratedprofiles-banner-preset-sunset: Label for the sunset gradient banner preset.
integratedprofiles-banner-preset-forest: Label for the forest gradient banner preset.
integratedprofiles-banner-preset-midnigh: Label for the midnight gradient banner preset.
integratedprofiles-banner-preset-ember: Label for the ember gradient banner preset.
integratedprofiles-banner-preset-sand: Label for the sand gradient banner preset.
integratedprofiles-banner-preset-aurora: Label for the aurora gradient banner preset.
integratedprofiles-banner-preset-custom: Label for the custom uploaded banner option.
integratedprofiles-field-about: Label for the short masthead tagline preference.

integratedprofiles-field-about-placehold: Placeholder for the tagline field in the profile editor.
integratedprofiles-field-featured-articl: Label for the featured wiki article preference.
Help text for the featured article page-title preference.
Placeholder for the featured article field in the profile editor.

integratedprofiles-field-website-help: Help text for the website preference.

integratedprofiles-field-github: Label for the GitHub username preference.

integratedprofiles-field-mediawiki: Label for the MediaWiki.org username preference.

integratedprofiles-field-mediawiki-place: Placeholder for the MediaWiki.org username field in the profile editor.
integratedprofiles-field-miraheze: Label for the Miraheze username preference.
integratedprofiles-field-miraheze-help: Help text for the Miraheze username preference.
integratedprofiles-field-miraheze-placeh: Placeholder for the Miraheze username field in the profile editor.
integratedprofiles-field-fandom: Label for the Fandom username preference.
integratedprofiles-field-fandom-help: Help text for the Fandom username preference.
integratedprofiles-field-fandom-placehol: Placeholder for the Fandom username field in the profile editor.
integratedprofiles-field-visibility: Label for who can see profile details.
integratedprofiles-field-visibility-help: Short help under the visibility control. Says About, contributions, and talk stay public.
integratedprofiles-visibility-public-hel: Short description under the Everyone option.
integratedprofiles-visibility-users-help: Short description under the Signed-in users option.
integratedprofiles-visibility-private: Visibility option label: only the owner.
integratedprofiles-visibility-private-he: Short description under the Only me option. Mentions moderators.
integratedprofiles-private-notice: Notice on the profile when details are hidden from the viewer.
integratedprofiles-field-hide-connection: Toggle label to hide verified Discord/Roblox badges on the public profile.
Help text for the hide-connected-accounts preference.
integratedprofiles-connections-title: Heading for the connected-accounts block in the profile editor.
integratedprofiles-connections-manage: Owner-only link in the profile editor to Special:Preferences connected accounts.
integratedprofiles-connection-discord: Label for a Discord linked account badge.
integratedprofiles-connection-roblox: Label for a Roblox linked account badge.
integratedprofiles-connection-verified: Accessible label fragment marking a NewAuth-verified connection icon.
integratedprofiles-connection-linked:
Status when a provider is linked. Parameters:
* $1 - remote display name
integratedprofiles-connection-not-linked: Status when a provider is not linked.
integratedprofiles-connection-manage: Short link label to edit an already-linked provider in Preferences.
integratedprofiles-connection-connect: Short link label to connect a provider in Preferences.
integratedprofiles-connection-external-h: Subtle help under each Discord/Roblox row explaining edits happen outside this form.
integratedprofiles-tab-about: Label for the About profile body tab (userpage/talk wikitext).
integratedprofiles-tab-contributions: Label for the Contributions tab (links to Special:Contributions with profile chrome).
integratedprofiles-tabs-label: Accessible name for the profile body tab navigation.
integratedprofiles-error-permission: API/UI error when the actor cannot edit the subject profile.
integratedprofiles-error-user-not-found:
API error when the username does not resolve. Parameters:
* $1 - username
integratedprofiles-error-invalid-fields:
API error listing invalid field keys. Parameters:
* $1 - comma-separated keys
integratedprofiles-error-invalid-json: API error when fields is not JSON.
integratedprofiles-error-avatar-upload: API error for generic avatar upload failure.
integratedprofiles-error-avatar-delete: API error for generic avatar removal failure.
integratedprofiles-error-avatar-type: API error for unsupported avatar MIME type.
integratedprofiles-error-avatar-animated: API/UI error when an animated avatar is uploaded without integratedprofiles-animated-avatar.
integratedprofiles-error-banner-upload: API error for generic banner upload failure.
integratedprofiles-error-banner-delete: API error for generic banner removal failure.
integratedprofiles-error-banner-type: API error for unsupported banner MIME type.
integratedprofiles-error-upload-too-larg: UI error when a proxy rejects the upload body (HTTP 413 / client_max_body_size) before MediaWiki can validate size.
